actions.action: Separate private requirements from public seat lists
actions.mechanism: Publish a minimal placement view rather than sharing the working spreadsheet or hiding sensitive columns.
actions.implementation: Restrict the master to seating staff. Record functional needs without medical details; export only attendee identifiers, tables, and seats.
actions.check: Open the attendee-facing export as an attendee; confirm notes, requirement flags, hidden sheets, and master access are absent.
actions.risk: Seat locations may suggest needs; never publish accommodation labels.

actions.action: Allocate clear-route seats before considering pairs
actions.mechanism: Treat the four qualifying seats as limited hard-need capacity; optimize pair preferences only within feasible assignments.
actions.implementation: Flag qualifying seat IDs, assign required placements first, then consider pairs. Leave excess access requests explicitly unresolved for private follow-up.
actions.check: Request a late pair with only separated seats remaining: offer separated placements without displacing hard needs. A fifth access request remains unresolved.
actions.risk: Never describe an unresolved access request as confirmed seating.

actions.action: Lock confirmed accessible placements against automatic changes
actions.mechanism: A protected assignment requires attendee contact before removal; cancellation updates cannot silently release or overwrite it.
actions.implementation: Store protected assignments and contact records. Preview each change; block removal or relocation until contact is recorded and any replacement satisfies requirements.
actions.check: Attempt reshuffling and a staff-entered cancellation without recorded contact: both must preserve the protected placement. Log authorized changes.
actions.risk: An unanswered contact attempt must not count as contact.

actions.action: Verify clear routes against the actual room
actions.mechanism: Spreadsheet eligibility depends on physical conditions; moved furniture or belongings can invalidate an otherwise correct assignment.
actions.implementation: Before opening, check all four designated routes against the venue’s access requirements. Keep routes unobstructed; recheck after layout changes.
actions.check: Simulate an obstruction at one designated seat: staff must detect it and restore the route before seating, without silently moving its attendee.
actions.risk: If restoration fails, contact the attendee and leave the issue unresolved.
